card.name: Points where a section reference comes next
card.fires_on: Spots in drug labels just before a section name or number is expected, such as after 'see', 'subsection of', or a section number like 7.2. Also fires on the digit after a section number's dot.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: The digit after the dot in a numbered heading, like 7.2 or 5.2.
modes.example: Administer calcium free phosphate binders at least 2 hours after mycophenolate mofetil. Examples Sevelamer 7.<<2>> Effect of Mycophenolate M

modes.label: Cross-reference cues
modes.description: Words such as 'see', 'in', or 'of' that lead into a named section of the label.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write the word 'section' next.
card.plain: It marks the place in a label where a pointer to another section, such as 'see Section 5', is about to appear.
